encoder.scope: 24 fixed TRAIN games; personally visible living entities only. M01 current-vector keeps nearest3/category and count, omitting entity type/buffs/abilities/cooldowns even for nearest entities. Candidate grid DOES retain aggregates from ALL visible positions/HP/distances; do not claim every far entity disappears. Action classifier does not directly receive that grid.

representation_collisions.scope: Assessed TRAIN label consistency at identical ENCODED inputs, not identical full personal evidence. Excludes unsupported args only for this diagnostic, retains all benchmark rows elsewhere. Ambiguity can reflect discarded information, missing longer history or stochastic behavior; cannot establish inherent unobservability/randomness. Unique inputs do not prove learnability.
